source_caption_text:
That one song that can take you straight back to 2018 🤒🔥

When you hear those first few guitar notes from Juice WRLD’s “Lucid Dreams,” it’s almost impossible not to get taken straight back to 2018. The song had a sound that felt completely different at the time, blending that soft guitar melody with Juice’s emotional vocals and the heavy 808s underneath. It was everywhere that year, and you could hear it coming from phones, cars, speakers, and pretty much every playlist.

What made “Lucid Dreams” hit so hard was how easily people connected with Juice WRLD’s heartbreak. He took the feeling of being stuck thinking about someone after a breakup and turned it into something incredibly catchy without losing the emotion behind it. His melodic delivery made every part of the song feel personal, which is a big reason why it became one of those tracks people attached their own memories to.

Years later, “Lucid Dreams” still feels like a time capsule for 2018. Those opening guitar notes alone can bring back a whole era, from the music everyone was listening to at the time to the places and people you associate with it. Some songs remind you of a moment, but this one really feels like it can take you back there.
